ios.desc:
Say goodbye to word memorization. With BrainOfWords, learning feels like a game.

BrainOfWords is carefully designed for anyone looking to expand their vocabulary in a fun and lasting way. It helps you learn without traditional memorization, using interactive techniques that make learning effective and enjoyable.

Key Features:
Gamified word learning experience

Daily goals and smart reminders

Mini memory games that test your skills

Level system and achievement badges

Compete with friends on leaderboards

Reinforce learned words through spaced repetition

Ideal for:
Students

Language learners

Adults looking to improve memory

Anyone who wants to learn while having fun

Download now and master the words.
BrainOfWords – Not memorization. A game.

Subscription Information:
You can purchase an auto-renewing subscription via in-app purchases:

Monthly: $1.99

Yearly: $9.99

Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Subscriptions cannot be canceled during the active subscription period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
